pages.text: "It's all mine!" Grandma took a roast sweet potato from the brazier. Yuki hugged it close and turned away. Brown dog Momo came sniffing beside them.
"You already ate. I'll eat all this." Yuki peeled it, and steam rose from the yellow inside. Momo moved across the brazier and lay with their back turned.
Yuki blew and took a bite. Sweet! But the space behind felt empty somehow. "...Oh? It's no fun at all."
Grandma sat beside Yuki in gray layered clothes. "If it's sweet, why are your shoulders drooping?" Yuki tilted their head. "It is sweet... but it's strange."
Grandma nodded toward the other side. Momo lay facing away, tail drooping. "Eating alone fills your tummy, but not your heart."
Yuki broke the remaining potato in two. Steam rose from both pieces. "Momo, Half Is Momo's!" Yuki offered the bigger piece.
Momo jumped up and came running, tail swinging. Front paws enclosed the warm half while Momo ate. Yuki ate beside them. The same potato tasted better now.
After eating, Momo rested their chin on Yuki's knees. Yuki gently rubbed Momo's ears. "Grandma, now my heart is full, too!"
Days later, Grandma buried another potato in the brazier. Yuki sat in front and fixed the scarf knot. "One, break it in half! Two, offer the bigger piece first!"
On Grandma's lap, Yuki offered a steaming half to Momo. Grandma touched cheeks with Yuki. "Sharing doesn't halve the taste; it doubles it." "Half Is Momo's!"
